top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as AI Slowdown Worries Hit Chipmakers
top_signals.summary: A selloff in chipmakers dragged down stocks after leaders of artificial-intelligence giants proposed slowing the technology’s development, with a rally in oil also weighing on sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
